notes: REF-BM-02: collects title/description/favicon but never a preview image (no such field). REF-BM-03: title/description editable after save via edit dialog, but the add form only exposes url+tags, so auto-collected metadata cannot be reviewed/edited before saving. REF-BM-04: edits url/title/description/tags but there is no note field at all. REF-BM-12: full-text search covers title/description/url (and tags) but note is not searchable because notes are not implemented. REF-BM-14: no #tag search syntax; # is treated as an ordinary substring, never matching tag keys. REF-BM-15: no AND/OR/NOT or parenthesised grouping; search is a plain LIKE substring. REF-BM-16: no quoted-phrase exact-match handling. REF-BM-17/18/19: no unread/read-later flag, no unread view, no mark-as-read. REF-BM-20/21: no multi-select or bulk actions and no whole-collection filter-scoped action. REF-BM-22: list is hardcoded to ORDER BY created_at DESC with no user-selectable sort key. REF-BM-23: no markdown note storage or rendering. REF-BM-24/25: no local HTML/PDF snapshot and no Internet Archive integration. REF-BM-26/27/28: no archive flag, no archive/delete distinction, no archived view. REF-BM-29: no saved bundles/filters. REF-BM-30/31: no Netscape HTML import or export. REF-BM-32: no user/display settings (default sort, items per page, font size).
